_comment_schema: auto_today: when true, GUI auto-computes letter_date, month_roman, year_num, and letter_number prefix from today's date. month_name / month_year / end_of_month_date are ALWAYS derived from the XLSX FILENAME (e.g. 'Smartpayer April 2026 X.xlsx' → month_year='April 2026', end_of_month_date='31 May 2026' = last day of NEXT month after the filename's month, as a full date string); they are independent of auto_today. auto_rates: when true, daily_rate / annual_rate / rate_multiplier_num / rate_multiplier_word are derived from the XLSX (daily_rate cell above 'Simulasi Imbalan' × 100 → annual = ×365 → multiplier = annual/deposit_rate → word = Indonesian spelling). discount_from and discount_until are ALWAYS auto-derived per-file from the XLSX header date columns and never read from this file. letter_date_num was renamed to year_num (last two digits of the year).
